scope: Official Wan2.2-Animate-14B tail-window launcher and image-transport failures before sampling
summary: The first launch was NOT STARTED because the remote launcher lacked the face-control flag; the second reached model loading but both seeds failed at upstream libpng decoding of src_ref.png, with no generated candidate promoted.
evidence: The first two seed processes returned code 2 before GPU sampling and wrote only argparse logs.
After synchronizing the tested launcher, both seed processes failed with libpng bad-parameter errors followed by cv2.imread(src_ref_path) returning None.
The original reference image independently decoded with both Pillow and OpenCV, isolating the failure to the upstream compressed reference transport path.
lessons: Remote launcher/version parity must be part of preflight, not inferred from checkpoint availability.
Image transport is an infrastructure contract; a decoder failure must not be treated as a bad model seed.
limitations: No candidate video was produced by these two attempts.
next_actions: Use pixel-preserving uncompressed PPM reference transport and retain the original/transport SHA-256 values.
